page.overview:
Who is Stewart?

As a human, Stewart was a white man with straight dirty blonde hair, a blonde beard, black eyes, light skin, and a thin figure. He wore a blue sweatshirt with brown pants, white sneakers, an orange baseball hat, a white bicycle helmet, and red gauges.

Stewart is a mutant whitefish with straight dirty blonde hair, a blonde beard, yellow sclerae, and grey scales. He wears his usual outfit pre-mutation excluding his bicycle helmet.

Stewart is quite laid-back and airy, initially excited by the prospect of being a part of an experiment that changes the nature of a human.

Stewart debuted "Mystic Mayhem". He was in the middle of completing a delivery with a customer when Agent 64 and the Guardsmen collided into him during their pursuit. Later that night, Stewart was accidentally teleported to the Hidden City while riding his bicycle where he was held captive by Baron Draxum in his laboratory. Draxum tested his newly remade ooze on him and after Stewart was mutated into a whitefish he fled from his laboratory in a panic.
